description: R3 refined seven-port candidate before lid fan addition; original timestamps and hashes preserved.

geometry.scope: Exact OCCT solid booleans. Nonzero intentional seating contact is not permitted as overlap.
notVerified: specific HDD connector geometry and insertion depth

cartridgeLift.includes: Exact printed pieces, five 9.5 mm HDD envelopes, fan/CM5/cooler design envelopes, four fan screw heads, conservative solid envelope of all native board components.
cartridgeLift.limitations: Discrete poses only. Zero overlap of conservative solid envelopes proves clearance at these poses; a nonzero envelope result needs exact-solid follow-up. Wiring, screw heads, solder tails and actual mating depths are excluded.

mating.scope: Exact B-rep nominal mating only. Printed shrinkage, warpage and fit feel are not measured.

mesh.scope: Exported binary STL edge topology and oriented volume. Does not prove self-intersection freedom, slicing, print supports or physical fits.

repository.sourceHtmlLinkBasis: src/index.html is a build template; local links are checked on generated index.html, and source main.mjs existence is checked.
repository.r2Builds: Dark full --audit and light build passed; historical R2 report bytes restored.
repository.r3Build: Absolute build.mjs from /tmp with bundled Node; final browser hashes match.

io-clearance.scope: Fresh native front-face planes and continuous straight gauges through the case wall. The USB-C open shell is checked by exact surface distance, not treated as a valid solid. The gauges are connector-mouth/tool envelopes; they do not model actual cable boots, latches, full insertion travel, button force/travel, or printing deviations.

materialGeometry.scope: B-rep material and contact geometry only; no stiffness, fatigue or vibration proof.

service-access.scope: Current exact spine/carriers/native board, 9.5 mm drive boxes. HDD and rear-fan fastening occur with shell absent. Driver shaft is diameter 6 mm; fingertip is only a static diameter 14 mm short cylinder, not a hand model. M2.5x6 engagement assumes a 1.6 mm PCB and no washer. Does not prove heat-set insert fit, full hand access, wire route or physical assembly.

board-clearance.scope: Fresh exact B-rep cylinders. Support/head/tool exclude PCB seat contact; shanks also check PCB hole walls. Does not validate absent CM5/cooler/wifi, real solder tails, actual hardware/tool geometry or printed fits.

all CAD I/O profiles bind to native connectors and can be selected
four view presets and both board sides
deterministic explode slider and arbitrary return
three thickness modes preserve the SATA X datum; five bay selections
skeleton-only view exposes the actual spine and restores the complete assembly
keyboard scopes to the scene and reset works
dark theme and free orbit render
390px layout and every view remain usable
reduced motion and offscreen render pause
browser.boundary: Browser checks only. CAD interference, physical fits, slicing, thermal and tool access require separate evidence.
